g.title: LEG
g.text: Rectangle = entity | Double rectangle = weak entity
Diamond = relationship | Double diamond = identifying relationship
Underlined = primary key | Dashed ellipse + underline = partial key
Double line = total participation | Single line = partial
ISA: disjoint, partial (ADMIN users belong to no subtype)
